title: M6 design correction: a 15 % target exposure does NOT guarantee a drawdown below 18 % (claim withdrawn)
reason: Owner instruction (Issue #2, M6-S0): the M6-DESIGN-01 statement that E_max = 0.15 makes shutdown impossible by construction is withdrawn. Repeated replenishment compounds losses (1000 -> 850 -> 722.50 is a 27.75 % drawdown absent intervention); V3 may or may not block replenishment, which is verified in M6-S0 and not assumed; target and realized exposure differ (drift between rebalances); equity is measured against the high-water mark, not the previous level; a single-event bound is not a cumulative bound; the normal 3-sigma approximation is not a hard bound. The design document is preserved unchanged; this amendment supersedes only the claim.

claim_corrections.withdrawn: Shutdown through the sleeve's own loss is therefore impossible by construction
claim_corrections.replacement: A single total loss of a 15 % sleeve costs at most 15 % of equity at that moment; cumulative loss, drift between rebalances, V3 integrity alarms (delistings, stale candles) and gaps are not bounded by the cap. Whether V3 prevents shutdown is tested in M6-S0, not assumed.

unchanged_parameters: N 45, families 1 of 3, every cap, V3 limits, T1-T10
